title: Sales managers see someone else's account names in the pipeline view
area: API design: REST, GraphQL, idempotency, pagination
scenario: Since the sprint 44 deploy, Americas sales managers sometimes see an EMEA customer's name on their own deals in Keystone's pipeline view, and the agent assistant repeated it. A renamed account kept its old name until a pod restarted. Support blames the CDN. You get the ticket, request and outbound-call logs, the sprint's git log and the GraphQL read layer.
task: Reproduce and find the root cause in the GraphQL read layer; test the CDN theory against the evidence
Fix it without reintroducing the N+1
Explain both symptoms with quoted evidence in ANSWER.md and propose prevention and the security follow-up
acceptance: Two tenants, sequential or interleaved, see only their own accounts
Every accounts-svc batch carries the right request's auth; renames show on the next request
Still one accounts-svc call per request

practices.label: Week 4 Thu - GraphQL read layer and DataLoader
Week 2 Thu - row-level security for tenancy
